name: 聪聪学堂
subtitle: 课本闯关、课文听读与错题复习
promotionalText: 从一节小课开始，练习、听读、复习都有清晰的下一步。免费使用，无广告、无应用内付费；已下载内容可离线学习。
description:
聪聪学堂是一款免费、开源的课本学习工具，将语文、数学、英语、科学教材的知识点组织成小课与学习路径。

【跟着课本练习】
选择年级、学科与教材版本，按单元学习。每节小课提供多种互动题型、即时答案反馈与解析。

【课文听读与本机跟读】
逐句点读、全文朗读，配合课外故事与阅读练习。跟读录音仅临时保存在本机，不上传；首次使用麦克风前会请家长确认。

【错题复习】
练习中的错题自动进入错题本，按掌握情况安排复习。学习进度、每日目标与成就帮助记录积累。

【适合 iPhone 和 iPad】
支持深色模式与 iPad 布局，提供学习概览 Widget。可导出学习存档，并在系统 iCloud 可用时同步至自己的 Apple 账户。分享学习卡、存档或题目反馈前需要家长确认。

无需注册，无广告，无应用内付费。部分基础数学内容随 App 提供；其他教材、故事与朗读音频需要联网下载，已下载内容可离线使用。排行榜中的学伴为本地模拟，不提供用户聊天或真实用户竞赛。

教材及配套内容版权归相应权利人所有；客户端代码采用 MIT 许可开源。内容包括不同年级的文学和历史课文，请结合商店年龄分级与自身需求选择使用。
keywords: 课本,练习,数学,语文,英语,科学,错题本,朗读,闯关,教育,学习,教材,阅读
reviewNotes:
No sign-in or test account is required. The app is free, with no advertising or in-app purchases. Basic grade-one math data and first-lesson audio are bundled. Additional textbooks, passages, stories and AAC audio download from the project's public GitHub Release; internet access is required for those downloads, and downloaded material works offline.

Suggested review: choose a math book, use the home continue button, finish the knowledge introduction, answer a question and view its feedback. Review, shop and profile are available from the main navigation. The shop uses earned virtual gems only; gems cannot be purchased or redeemed for money. League companions are simulated locally, with no real-user competition or chat.

The in-app privacy policy is available in Profile > Settings, including offline. Before outbound sharing, the first microphone permission request, and notification permission requests, an adult must solve the local parental challenge. These gates do not collect age or identity. Follow-along recordings remain temporary on-device files and are deleted when leaving the reader. Private iCloud progress uses Apple's system service and cannot be read by the developer.

The publisher confirms that distributed textbook passages, stories and illustrations are owned, public-domain, or appropriately licensed. The catalogue includes occasional literary/historical references to warfare, weapons, alcohol or tobacco; the age-rating questionnaire reflects those contents. Initial distribution excludes China mainland.
